name: Avengers Compound
significance: Primary headquarters for the Avengers, location of the Time Heist staging, destroyed in 2023 Battle of Earth.

name: Kingdom of Wakanda
significance: Vibranium-rich technological stronghold; site of the 2018 defense against the Black Order and Thanos' initial Snap.

name: Titan
significance: Ruined celestial world where Iron Man, Spider-Man, Doctor Strange, and Guardians confronted Thanos.

name: Vormir
significance: Desolate realm of the Soul Stone requiring a soul for a soul sacrifice.

name: New Asgard (Tønsberg)
significance: Refugee settlement founded by Thor and Valkyrie for surviving Asgardians.

name: The Garden (Planet 0259-S)
significance: Thanos' retirement sanctuary where he atomized the Infinity Stones and was executed by Thor.
